ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Process Start Locations
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious process run from unusual locations

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\RECYCLER\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\SystemVolumeInformation\\\\.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\debug\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\fonts\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\help\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\drivers\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\addins\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\cursors\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\tasks\\\\")))
